name: gherkin-behat-linker
description: Bidirectional navigation between Gherkin .feature steps and Behat PHP step definitions — static analysis, zero PHP, exact Behat matching semantics

gherkinBehat.enabled.description: Index the workspace (navigation + diagnostics). Set to false to turn the extension off — no file is read, no diagnostic is emitted.

gherkinBehat.features.description: Glob(s) of Gherkin feature files to index. vendor/ and node_modules/ are always excluded. v0: only the first workspace root is indexed.

gherkinBehat.steps.description: Glob(s) of PHP step definition files to index. vendor/ and node_modules/ are always excluded. v0: only the first workspace root is indexed.

gherkinBehat.orphans.description: Emit info diagnostics for orphan step definitions (no matching step).
